topPicks.rationale: Combines authority trigger with Guide bracket convention. Data-backed framing aligns with Reddit's preference for substantive content. High specificity increases click-through.
Warning archetype with loss-aversion trigger is the strongest pattern interrupt for TikTok. Short text works as both on-screen overlay and spoken hook within 2-second window.
Statistic hook with authority trigger drives shares on Facebook. Survey framing provides social proof. Surprise element ('wasn't what we expected') creates curiosity gap.
List archetype with explicit 'Save this' CTA optimizes for Instagram's save signal. Under 125-char preview limit. Micro-habits framing makes it actionable and save-worthy.

abPairs.rationale: Hook A uses authority trigger (data-backed) while Hook B uses curiosity trigger (personal story). Tests whether Reddit users respond more to data or narrative framing for wellness content.
Hook A uses direct imperative ('Stop doing...') while Hook B uses POV format. Tests whether negative framing (warning) outperforms positive framing (transformation) for hook completion rate.
Hook A uses personal question format (drives comments) while Hook B uses survey data (drives shares). Tests whether engagement comes from conversation or authority on Facebook.
Hook A uses positive framing (save-worthy tips) while Hook B uses negative framing (loss-aversion warning). Tests whether Instagram users respond more to gain or loss framing.
